An organic waste receiving facility will be constructed to receive, store, and feed approximately 150 tons of pre-processed food waste slurry to the digester complex at Plant No. 2 (by Digester M) to generate additional digester gas per recommendations of the Biosolids Master Plan.
Build a 6 MG equalization storage tank at Plant No. 2 to store secondary effluent during peak day flows and be returned to the system during low flow periods to maintain a constant flow to the GWRS.
Build a Plant 2 effluent pump station that will convey approximately 50-85 MGD of secondary effluent from Plant No. 2 trickling filter solids contact process to the GWRS Facility.

Modify Plant 2 Headworks Facility to create a reclaimable and non-reclaimable treatment train. Reclaimable flows will go through existing preliminary, primary, and secondary (trickling filter solids contact) treatment before being pumped to GWRS.

Advanced treatment for the GWRS includes microfiltration, reverse osmosis, and advance oxidation (ultraviolet/peroxide). ... In 2023, when the Final Expansion of the GWRS is complete, Treatment Plant No. 2 effluents will also be reclaimed at the GWRS.
